title: Orders table overflows its card at tablet width
symptom: Table cells are set to never wrap. With long customer names plus localised dates and headings (stress content), the six-column orders table becomes wider than its card at tablet widths (768 to ~890 px), sticking out of the card and making the whole page scroll sideways by over 100 px, with the Status column off-screen. The same happens again just above 1024 px, where the sidebar returns and narrows the content.
